title: feat(dashboard): Refresh All sits in the dashboard page header; DashboardRenderer gains onRefreshStateChange (objectui#12554)
body:
Fixes #12554
Clause-②: yes — `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`'s published `DashboardRendererProps` gains ONE optional host option, `onRefreshStateChange` (a widening). Nothing else on the public surface changes: no schema, accept set, export or i18n key moves.

## What changed

- **`DashboardRenderer`** gains `onRefreshStateChange`, declared beside `hideHeaderText`: a callback taking `DashboardAutoRefresh | null`, the return type of `useDashboardAutoRefresh` by reference.
  - Set: the renderer draws no refresh button of its own, and reports the state of its one refresh implementation: `{ refreshing, handleRefresh }` on mount and on each change of `refreshing`, and `null` when no `onRefresh` is wired or the renderer unmounts.
  - Unset: nothing changes. Every other host of the renderer (`DashboardPreview`, `DashboardWithConfig`, the SDUI `dashboard` node) draws its own button as before.
  - **One timer.** `useDashboardAutoRefresh(schema, onRefresh)` is still the only auto-refresh timer, armed by `onRefresh` and the authored `refreshIntervalSeconds`, whose semantics are untouched. `DashboardView` runs no timer.
  - **Shape, measured.** The renderer's host callbacks are `on`-prefixed (`onRefresh`, `onWidgetClick`, `onWidgetsReorder`), and a state report in this tree is spelled `on…StateChange`: `ObjectGrid` and `ListView` `onColumnStateChange`, and `FlowSimulatorPanel` `onRunStateChange`, which reports `null` the same way. The option carries state back, so it takes that callback shape rather than the `hide…` boolean shape of `hideHeaderText`.
  - The report is keyed on VALUES only (whether the host takes the control, whether a handler is wired, `refreshing`). The host callback and `handleRefresh` are read through refs, so a host may pass a new function each render (AGENTS.md #10). It is a layout effect, so the header button paints with the dashboard rather than one frame later.
  - The record-count badge (`recordCount`) is not handed over; it stays where the renderer draws it.
- **`DashboardView`** passes `onRefreshStateChange={setRefreshState}` and draws Refresh All in `PageHeader`'s `actions` from the report:
  - the same three pack keys (`dashboard.refreshAll` / `dashboard.refreshDashboard` / `dashboard.refreshing`) through the same `useSafeTranslate`, with the same English fallbacks; no new i18n key;
  - the same `RefreshCw` icon with `animate-spin` while refreshing, `variant="outline" size="sm"`, disabled while refreshing;
  - a click calls the renderer's `handleRefresh`, so the indicator shows on manual and timed runs alike.
- **Docs.** `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` gains a section on the option (prose, no code fence). `packages/app-shell/README.md` and `content/docs/guide/console.md` said the button sat above the widgets; they now say it sits in the page header.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/12554-dashboard-refresh-in-page-header.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` minor, `@object-ui/app-shell` minor.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured at base `baab2d6ed0`

- **A1 holds.** `DashboardView` passed `onRefresh={refreshDashboardData}` and `hideHeaderText` to `DashboardRenderer`.
- **A2 holds only for a dashboard with nothing else above its widgets.** Under `hideHeaderText` the renderer's rows above the widgets are its header row, drawn only for `header.actions`, and its toolbar row, the filter bar of `dateRange` / `globalFilters`. With the button gone:
  - no filter bar and no `header.actions`: no row at all, zero grid items above the widgets (pinned);
  - a filter bar: the row stays, holding the filter bar alone (pinned). HotCRM's Sales Performance declares `dateRange` and two `globalFilters`, so its row stays, with the date range, Sales Rep and Deal Type and no button at its right end;
  - `header.actions`: the header row stays, holding its actions;
  - a host that passes `recordCount` keeps the badge in that row (pinned). `DashboardView` passes none.
- **A3 holds in half.** The button must call the hook's `handleRefresh`: that is what lights `refreshing` and calls `onRefresh`, and it is what the header button calls. But a manual refresh does not reset the timer, today or now: the interval is armed on the period and on whether a handler is wired, and `handleRefresh` does not touch it. Manual and timed runs share the indicator, not the phase. Behaviour is unchanged.

## Edit Layout and design-mode buttons

`DashboardRenderer` draws neither. `designMode` only adds widget selection affordances, and "Edit Layout" belongs to `DashboardGridLayout`, which `DashboardView` does not mount. `DashboardView` passes no `designMode`. So Refresh All is the page header's one action, and nothing was left behind in the renderer's row.

## Tests

New pins:

- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.hostRefreshControl-12554.test.tsx`, 11 cases on the real renderer. With the option: no button, the idle report on mount; the reported `handleRefresh` calls `onRefresh` once and reports the indicator on, then off after 600ms; the authored 30s timer still calls `onRefresh` (1 at 30s, 3 at 95s) and its run is reported; `null` with no `onRefresh` and on unmount; a host storing the report through an inline arrow renders a bounded number of times; the console-chrome row collapses; the filter-bar row stays without the button; the record-count badge stays. CONTROL: the same mounts without the option draw the renderer's button, alone in its row and in the filter-bar row.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/DashboardView.refreshInHeader-12554.test.tsx`, 5 cases through the real view, renderer, hook and bus. One refresh button on the page, inside `page-header`. A click declares one `{ objectName: '*' }` change, and while it is pending the button is disabled, reads "Refreshing…" and its icon spins; after 600ms it is idle again. An authored 60s period lights the header button. A zh session reads the zh pack's three values, with a control that the zh values differ from the en ones.

Unchanged pins that still hold:

- `DashboardView.autoRefresh-11062.test.tsx`, the authored-period pin. Its manual-click case now clicks the header button, found by the same accessible name.
- `DashboardView.pageHeader-12526.test.tsx`: one Refresh All on the page.
- `DashboardRenderer.refreshRow-11694.test.tsx` and `DashboardRefreshButton.locale-11097.test.tsx`: renderer hosts without the option.

Runs at `1ea909601f`, from the repo root, under the shared verify lock:

- Every suite that names `DashboardRenderer` or `DashboardView` (87, the two new ones included), plus the census and ratchet suites that may read a changed file (215 candidates from `git grep -l -E 'census|ratchet|WRITE_SITES|AFFORDANCE_GRANTS' -- '*.test.ts*'`, narrowed to those naming the dashboard files, a package tree scan, READMEs, changesets, docs, `aria-label`, `lucide` or `PageHeader`), deduplicated: `Test Files 289 passed (289)`, `Tests 8432 passed (8432)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check` exit 0 and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0. Both run `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, whose includes take the new tests. They ran after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` (28 tasks, exit 0); the built `DashboardRenderer.d.ts` declares `onRefreshStateChange`.

## Ablations

Each went through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit once, blob changed, then restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`). The test files resolve `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` to `src` through the root vitest alias, so no `dist/` leg applies.

1. **Drop `onRefreshStateChange={setRefreshState}` from `DashboardView`.** 4 failed, all in the new view pin: `the refresh button is not in the page header`. The direction differs from the dispatch's prediction of two buttons: there is ONE button, the renderer's, below the header, because the header has no state to draw from. `11062` and `12526` stay green under this ablation (10 passed), which is why the new view pin exists.
2. **Renderer draws its button despite the option.** Two buttons; 7 failed, including `12526`'s `one "Refresh All" control on the page` and the new pins' `the renderer drew a second refresh button`.
3. **Report keyed on the callback's identity.** `Maximum update depth exceeded`; the bounded-render pin fails.

## Gates

Local, each exit captured before any pipe:

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| `check:control-bytes` | 0 |
| `check:new-line-citations` | 0, `0 new citation(s)` |
| `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | 0 |
| `check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 |
| `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` | 0 |
| `check:changeset-claims` | 0 (report-only) |
| `check:pending-changeset-literals` | 0 |
| `check:i18n-keys` | 0 |
| eslint on the four changed source and test files | 0 errors. The 17 warnings all sit on lines this diff does not touch. |
| `check:readme-exports` | **NOT MEASURED**: exit 1 with "the population COLLAPSED", because 18 packages are unbuilt in this worktree, a prerequisite and not a verdict. The README edits add prose and no fenced block, which is what it reads. CI runs it on a full build. |

CI runs the full farm. ⚠️ `Spec Main Shape Gate` is red on `main` (objectui#12464) and is advisory.

## What the landing seat's browser reading should show

At 1440 on HotCRM's Sales Performance dashboard (`sales_dashboard`, `refreshIntervalSeconds: 180`):

- ONE page header row: the dashboard icon chip, "Sales Performance", the description beside it, and **Refresh All at the right end of that same row**.
- Below it, the filter bar row: date range (this quarter), Sales Rep, Deal Type. There is **no refresh button** at its right end and none anywhere below the header; the page has exactly one.
- Clicking Refresh All: for about 600ms it reads "Refreshing…", its icon spins and it is disabled; the widgets re-read in place.
- Every 180s the header button spins on its own: the timer is still running.
- A zh session reads the zh copy on the header button.

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface.** Beyond the claim's list, the diff edits three docs files. `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` gets a section on the new option (AGENTS.md #2). `packages/app-shell/README.md` and `content/docs/guide/console.md` placed the button above the widgets, which this change makes false. Those same two passages also said a dataset-bound KPI tile "does not re-read yet". That was already false: objectui#11095 is pinned by `DatasetWidget.kpiInvalidation-11095.test.tsx`, and `DashboardView`'s own handler docblock says so. The sentence sat in the passage being rewritten, so it now says what ships.
- `DashboardGridLayout` keeps its own refresh button. It is a separate surface that the console does not mount for a dashboard page, and it is out of scope.
- Pre-existing, unchanged: the record-count badge is drawn only when `onRefresh` is wired. The one in-repo caller that passes `recordCount`, `DashboardWithConfig`, has no in-repo host. Noted, not filed; carrier: none.

Implemented by the dispatched dev of `domain:ui` seat 1, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`, claim comment 6199269607.
